## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 18, 2026 - Aug 27, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Hulafhj_, Aug 26, 2026, 1/5: "MyFitnessPal is getting too complicated… Navigating the APP, adding food and etc is starting to feel like I’m jumping thru hoops and now the apps keeps freezing…I deleted and ddl it several times…still the same problem. This App no longer suits me…which is a shame…I lost 70lbs using your app in 2019. 😩damned myself by buying a year subscription"
            2. _Verczeska_, Aug 24, 2026, 1/5: "I have been a user since early 2010s. I loved it and I recommended it to all friends, family and clients. The new update made it all unusable, I find it hard to see what I actually consumed. Bring the old version back."
            3. _Jen,seeking resolution_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible navigation, continually have Mondays entries end up on the following Sunday, no longer is there mass delete, various editing functions gone, way more clicks to add and delete, hideous UI and UX, glitchy. Did anyone bother to even do a feature gap analysis before deploying this junk that has had nothing but terrible reviews none of which have they remedied or even addressed? Boycot these people"
<!--/ir-theme-->
